EXPERIENCE

Test & Validation Engineer | Corvane Automotive Components | Setúbal
Mar 2019–Present
- Plan and run durability, vibration and climatic tests on seat-adjuster mechanisms across six servo-hydraulic and electric test rigs; prepare reports for OEM customers.
- Develop Python scripts to parse TDMS and CSV rig outputs (around 2 GB per week), check channels against test specifications, and generate standard report figures. Reduced report preparation from about three days to half a day per test.
- Maintain an internal data-processing tool scheduled nightly on a laboratory PC. It writes summary results to a staging table in the plant’s SQL Server database and is used by four other test engineers.
- Query the plant’s test-results database for trend analysis across three product generations.
- Built a Power BI dashboard using the staging table to show pass/fail trends and cycles to failure by product generation; used by around 15 validation and design engineers.
- Correlate rig results with FEA in ANSYS Mechanical and lead 8D root-cause analysis on field failures. Proposed a redesigned adjuster rail bracket that cut warranty returns for the part by 40%.
- Maintain MATLAB/Simulink models of the adjuster drive, used to select rig load profiles that match customer duty cycles.
- Trained three apprentices in rig safety and test setup (2022–2024).

Sep 2014–Feb 2019

COVER LETTER

Dear Halden Pay Data Platform Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform role. After 12 years in mechanical engineering, testing and validation, I am moving toward data engineering, building on practical experience turning engineering test data into reliable checks, reports and decisions.

At Corvane Automotive Components, I developed Python scripts that process around 2 GB of TDMS and CSV test-rig output each week, check channels against specifications and generate report figures. This reduced report preparation from about three days to half a day per test. I also maintain a tool scheduled nightly on a laboratory PC that writes summary results to a SQL Server staging table and is used by four other test engineers. A Power BI dashboard built on that table gives around 15 validation and design colleagues visibility into pass/fail trends and cycles to failure. These projects have taught me to focus on dependable, reusable tools and the needs of the people who rely on their outputs.

My experience to date is with engineering data workflows and internal tools, rather than operating a cloud data platform. I am currently completing an online data engineering course, with six of nine modules completed, and am keen to continue developing in this field. Halden Pay’s focus on shared platform capabilities, collaboration across teams and taking ownership of problems particularly appeals to me. I am also happy to commute to Lisbon for a hybrid role.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my test-data automation experience could contribute to Halden Pay’s Data Platform team.

Best regards,
Tiago Ferrão-Lindqvist
